title: Logan Tutor ties for 12th, Grady Bledsoe for 18th at Class 4A state golf
excerpt: Two strokes separated South Pontotoc’s Tutor and North Pontotoc’s Bledsoe over 36 holes. South Pontotoc freshman Maddox Gleaves cut six strokes in the second round.
locality: South Pontotoc and North Pontotoc high schools. The championship was held in Choctaw, Mississippi.

paragraphs.text: South Pontotoc senior Logan Tutor and North Pontotoc sophomore Grady Bledsoe finished two strokes apart at the Class 4A boys state golf championship. Tutor tied for 12th at 166 and Bledsoe tied for 18th at 168. The Mississippi High School Activities Association published the full results Sunday for the October tournament at Dancing Rabbit Golf Club in Choctaw.

Tutor opened with an 82 on the first 18 holes, three shots better than Bledsoe’s 85. Bledsoe made one of those shots back in the second round, shooting 83 to Tutor’s 84. Both finished in the top 20 of the 72 golfers who turned in two completed rounds.
South Pontotoc freshman Maddox Gleaves made the biggest second-round improvement of the three county golfers. He followed an opening 96 with a 90 to finish 45th at 186.

Tishomingo County sophomore Spencer Kirk won the individual title at 147, seven strokes ahead of two Ripley golfers who shared second. Ripley won the team title with 642 strokes. Neither Pontotoc County school appears in the 11-team standings.
